title: GET SOME REST
message:
It’s a good time
to be in bed.

title: RELAX IN YOUR CHAIR
message:
You can kick back and rest
with your feet up.

title: READ A BOOK
message:
Use the tablet
beside your chair
to find a book to read.

title: WATCH SOME TV
message:
Use the tablet
beside your chair
to find a Movie or
TV show to watch.

title: HAVE A NAP
message:
You can always
take a quick nap
if you feel like it.

title: GO FOR A WALK
message:
You can take a short walk
down the hall to see 
what everyone is doing.

title: SIT ON THE PORCH
message:
You can sit in the rocking chairs,
out past the front desk.

title: GO BY THE FOUNTAIN
message:
You can go outside
in the courtyard.
Go all the way around
to the back doors.

title: HAVE A SNACK HERE
message:
If you’re hungry,
there are plenty of snacks
in your kitchen.

title: GET SOME COFFEE
message:
There are usually coffee 
and snacks right around the corner near the fireplace.

title: SEE IF CHEF WILL MAKE YOU A SNACK
message:
You can go to the dining room 
and ask the chef if he will 
make you something.

title:
TALK TO THE LADY 
AT THE FRONT DESK
message:
If you have a question,
or just want to chat,
you can talk to the lady
at the front desk.

title: DO A QUICK WORKOUT
message:
You can use the dumb bells
or kettle bell weights.
The gym is right outside 
your door, to the left.
